title: Fort Mackinac Officers’ Stone Quarters

buildingCutout.basis: Native outline enclosing the limestone block and its south gallery.

terrainReference.basis: Mapzen native terrain at the middle of the Officers’ Stone Quarters parade-facing walk. The harbor gallery has a lower exposed elevation.

mapIdentity.scope: Native outline and fort identity plus HABS MI-25 measured plans and elevations. Width is approximately 31.8 metres and the full survey ridge rises around 7.5 metres above the parade-ground grade.

note: The 1901 photograph shows the cliff-facing gallery and roof. HABS MI-25 sheets 1–3 dimension the hipped roof, stair entrances, fenestration and stone chimney stacks.
